programme: KLF4, PER2 and TGIF1 form the brake side of an epithelial-identity/EMT switch: KLF4 maintains epithelial differentiation and is destabilized to permit EMT in gastric cancer cells; PER2 directly represses the core EMT transcription factors SNAI2 and TWIST1 together with the TGF-beta/PAI-1 effector SERPINE1; TGIF1 dampens the same TGFB1-SERPINE1 arm. HOXD3 (targets ITGA5, ITGAV, ITGB1, ITGB3, ITGA3, MMP2, PLAU, WNT1), FOXP4 (a YAP1-driven stemness/metastasis effector) and HEYL (a Notch HES/HEY-family effector implicated in anoikis resistance) form the invasive, plasticity-executing arm that takes over once that brake is lost. NKX2-1 sits at the identity node itself: it defines lung/thyroid epithelial lineage identity, and its disruption marks the alveolar epithelial transdifferentiation documented in COVID-damaged lung and the aberrant transcriptional role described for it in gastric epithelium.
role_in_a: In COVID-19, this axis maps onto alveolar epithelial injury and repair: NKX2-1-marked lineage identity is disrupted during the epithelial transitions seen by single-cell profiling of COVID lung, and the same set of factors (KLF4, PER2, FOXP4, HEYL) surface in post-COVID transcriptional, circadian and severity literature, consistent with the epithelial repair programme being pushed toward a more plastic, partially mesenchymal state.
role_in_b: In gastric cancer this is the documented EMT/invasion circuit: KLF4 loss and destabilization permits EMT, PER2 knockdown de-represses SNAI2/TWIST1-driven EMT and drives immunotherapy resistance, FOXP4 acts downstream of YAP1 to drive stemness and metastasis, and HEYL and HOXD3-linked integrin/MMP/uPA expression are recurrent features of invasive, anoikis-resistant tumor signatures.
shared_axis: A virus-injured, regenerating alveolar epithelium and a transformed, invading gastric epithelium both draw on the same differentiation-state control circuit — the brake (KLF4/PER2/TGIF1) that normally holds an epithelium in place, the executors (HOXD3/FOXP4/HEYL) that drive local plasticity and invasion when it fails, and the lineage-identity node (NKX2-1) whose disruption marks the switch. Gastric cancer research has already dissected this as an EMT/stemness axis; COVID lung-repair biology is beginning to describe the same kind of epithelial transdifferentiation.
reasoning: Each half of this circuit is separately documented: KLF4/PER2/TGIF1 repression of EMT and HOXD3/FOXP4/HEYL execution of invasion and stemness are supported in the retrieved gastric-cancer literature, and NKX2-1-marked alveolar epithelial transition is directly documented in COVID lung tissue. No retrieved source connects the two diseases through this axis together, so the shared_axis is my inference across two separate literatures, not a citation. Strength is moderate rather than strong because most of the COVID-side evidence for the carrying factors (FOXP4 GWAS hits, HEYL methylation-severity, PER2/circadian-symptom papers, KLF4 in post-COVID cardiovascular expression) is associative rather than mechanistic epithelial-plasticity data — the NKX2-1 alveolar-transition paper is the one exception that is directly on-mechanism.
support: 41883394 (KLF4 inhibits EMT in gastric cancer cells); 40504295 (KLF4 mediates phenylethyl isothiocyanate's anti-gastric-cancer effect); 40849587 (RNF81 loss destabilizes KLF4, promoting gastric cancer progression); 40819217 (KLF4 in post-COVID cardiovascular transcriptional regulation); 37523502 (NKX2-1 marks alveolar epithelial transitions in COVID-19 BAL scRNA-seq); 36094595 (NKX2-1/TTF1 has an essential transcriptional role in gastric cancer); 39896874 (PER2/circadian disruption in long-COVID); 41928364 (PER2 knockdown drives metabolic reprogramming and immunotherapy resistance in gastric cancer); 39047223 (FOXP4 is a direct YAP1 target promoting gastric cancer stemness and metastasis); 40724930, 40399555, 39298002 (FOXP4 genetically associated with long COVID); 35655915 (HEYL promoter methylation associated with severe COVID-19); 42445388, 41438119, 41608646, 34157940 (HEYL appears in gastric-cancer prognostic/mechanistic signatures, including an anoikis-related SRPX2-FAK/AKT-IL6 axis); 38067260 (TGIF1 listed within a CDR1as/HuR-driven gastric cancer growth axis, weak/indirect). No PMID found for HOXD3 in either disease; its inclusion rests only on its integrin/MMP/uPA target set.
how_to_falsify: Knock down PER2 (or restore KLF4) in a COVID-relevant alveolar/airway organoid injury model, as has been done in gastric cancer, and test whether SNAI2, TWIST1 and SERPINE1 are induced or repressed the same way; if they are not, the EMT-brake role of these factors does not transfer to virus-damaged lung epithelium and the shared-axis claim fails. Complementary check: single-cell profiling of post-COVID lung versus gastric tumor tissue should show co-varying KLF4-low/HOXD3-high/HEYL-altered states if the same circuit is genuinely redeployed in both; independent, uncorrelated behavior across the two tissues would refute it.
caveats: The stated tissue pairing is blood|stomach, but the mechanism argued here is lung-epithelial (via NKX2-1); the COVID-side data in this network are blood-derived, one step removed from the alveolar biology being invoked. Support is drawn from 120 patient-group comparisons across 2 independent cohort pairs, with carrying-factor recurrence in the 52-66/120 range — moderate, not near-ceiling. Tissue-generic exclusion already removed several blood/immune master regulators (SPI1, FLI1, IRF1, IRF5, IKZF1, FOXO3/4, AR, BCL6, NCOA1, BRCA1, KLF9), so what remains is less likely to be a trivial shared-tissue artifact, but HOXD3 itself has no literature placement in either disease and is included on target-coherence grounds only. STAT4 is well evidenced in this same concordant set but reflects a distinct Th1/T-cell-exhaustion immune axis and was deliberately left out of this account rather than folded in. PEG3, MEIS3, POU3F1 and CXXC1 have no usable literature or clear pathway link to the rest and are excluded entirely.
